honest_assessment.algorithmic_novelty: NONE — SequentialConfidence_0.55_0.45 is standard two-stage softmax-max confidence thresholding, selected over ConditionalUtility after algebraic equivalence and empirical defeat.
honest_assessment.systems_contribution_scope: Engineering integration of fail-closed 12-byte TCP socket framing, monotonic deadline reserves, masked feature traps, and dual-endpoint video-cluster evaluation.
unresolved_tradeoffs: Persistent TCP Static_TA_Direct has lower tail latency (p95=0.82ms, p99=1.01ms) than SequentialConfidence (p95=1.28ms, p99=1.79ms).

Non-persistent TCP OneShot_ConfidenceRouting_0.55 has lower mean/p95/p99 latency (4.63/17.93/23.83ms) than SequentialConfidence (6.65/20.99/30.67ms) and saves 398 vs 265 B/q (-14.3% overall across 7 workloads, failing the 15% lower-CI margin against OneShot).
Unimodal_Text is even faster/cheaper (3.7 B/q, 0.23ms) with 0.5328 SQ-F1 vs 0.5415 (+0.0087 F1, 95% CI [-0.0081, +0.0269] crosses 0).
Localhost loopback sockets reflect same-host feature tensor transmission, not WAN network links, two physical devices, energy, or raw media ingestion.
